title: WorkflowStageResult
description: Single-envelope terminal payload for `crab run` (single-stage mode). Emitted under `--json` as `Envelope<WorkflowStageResult>` and under `--jsonl` as the final `result` event.

attempts.description: Number of attempts it took to reach success (always `>= 1`).

cache_hit.description: Whether the result came from the cache.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the attempt in milliseconds.

outs.description: Declared outputs with their content hashes and sizes.

side_effects_skipped.description: Set to `true` when a stage has `side_effects: true` but no `on_cache_hit` hook — the side effects were skipped on this cache hit.

source.description: Cache hit source: `"Local"`, `"Remote"`, or `"Execution"`. Present only when the stage was served from cache.

stage_name.description: Stage name as declared on the CLI.

WorkflowStageOut.description: One output recorded in a [`WorkflowStageResult`] or [`WorkflowStageHashed`] payload.

size.description: Size of the output in bytes.
